workload: SIFT100M A→B, 40K queries, each phase 10K uniform + 10K Zipf0.8 shuffled
modes: private one LRU per worker; retain across all queries and A→B phase boundary
cache_clear: sync + POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED per file; mincore verification
timing: Wall QPS across 40K measured queries. No per-query resets.
validation: All 40K×10 result IDs equal existing reference; per-query full-vector node counts unchanged; zero query-reset calls; all N/M counters zero; full D remains immutable.
scope: Only private payload capacity changes across runs. Same executable, 20 workers, dynamic OpenMP scheduling. No cross-thread sharing. Each process starts with empty prefetch. Payload excludes metadata and other index memory.
